infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SARJ needs access to your photo library so you can choose a profile picture for your customer account — for example, when you tap Edit Profile and select a photo from your library.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: SARJ may save images you choose when updating your profile photo.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SARJ can use the camera so you can take a new profile photo for your account.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: SARJ uses your location to show your live position to dispatch and for ride assignments — for example, while you are online as a driver on an active trip.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: SARJ uses your location in the background so dispatch can see you until you log out or close the app — for example, during an assigned chauffeur trip.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: SARJ uses your location in the background for live driver tracking during an assigned trip.

plugins.photosPermission: SARJ needs access to your photo library so you can choose a profile picture for your customer account — for example, when you tap Edit Profile and select a photo from your library.
plugins.cameraPermission: SARJ can use the camera so you can take a new profile photo for your account.
